jou.text: Word comes that the Nyxborn are attacking, and the narrator rushes with her company to the gate, where she realizes the Nyxborn, a mixed force of creatures with night-sky skin, are agents of the gods.

She realizes she has rushed into battle with only seven other soldiers against an army of unknown size, and they hold the bridge in a phalanx, knocking Nyxborn off the edge until weak reinforcements arrive.
A Nyxborn grabs and stabs the narrator six times and throws her against the sealed gates, and the Nyxborn retreat after the last soldier falls, and the gates reopen.
